findings.title: Sequential local streams and retries share a request-scoped cumulative thinking filter
guarantees: Streaming multi display accepts valid cumulative snapshots from every independent local variant
Thinking filter prefix validation must be scoped to one actual stream, not an entire multi-stream generation

steps: Enable streaming and streaming-multi; choose non-batch profile and two candidates on MLX or Ollama
First independent transport streams its completion and succeeds
Second independent transport streams a different completion; handler treats new prefix as malformed and suppresses interim output until final
reproduction.runtime: Lua 5.4.8 + repository Hammerspoon and transport doubles; no native Mac claim

root_cause.description: One filter/partial_raw_seen is retained for whole request while same callback receives independent cumulative strings from multiple variants and retries.

findings.silent_failure: Later token previews stop rendering but final candidates still succeed; only a cumulative-prefix warning identifies the mismatch. Failed partial plus retry has the same outcome.
findings.regression_test: Compose actual local strategy and handler for two successful independent streams and partial-failure/retry. Assert interim rendering for admitted streams and final candidates. Retain valid cumulative and malformed same-stream prefix controls, plus thinking-tag suppression.
